data.long_meaning: In Greek, Bobine means 'God is my strength'. This name is rooted in the ancient Greek belief in the power and protection of the gods. For Christian parents, the name Bobine carries a powerful spiritual significance, reminding them that strength and power come from their faith in God. The name Bobine carries the meaning “God is my strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bobine usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
